title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Megacap semis led, but breadth stayed narrow.
A 100% hike-odds Fed path didn't stop a growth melt-up: SOXX +4.93% and QQQ +2.77% carried the tape while RSP gained just 0.18% and small caps lagged by 2.25pp. With only 29% of S&P names above their 50-DMA and 71 new 60-day lows, this was a concentrated momentum trade, not broad risk-on — the index gain came from a handful of names while the average stock was ignored.

INDICES — VIX 14.9, below its 20-day MA of 15.7.
SOXX +4.93%, QQQ +2.77%, SPY +1.55%, DIA +0.76%, IWM +0.52%. Large > small by 2.25pp. Oil was the notable cross-asset outlier, USO -3.68%, dragging energy-linked complexes lower while TLT +0.68% rallied on retreating yields.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol 1.2x, QQQ 1.5x: both above average on up days, accumulation.
XLC 1.9x, XLK 1.4x and MAGS 3.3x saw the heaviest activity; GLD and SLV at 0.6x were ignored. Breadth: 291 advancers vs 208 decliners (58% up), up/down volume 2.10, but just 29% above the 50-DMA and 49% above the 200-DMA against 11 highs vs 71 lows — participation diverges sharply from the headline index move, confirming a narrow megacap tape.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLC Comms +3.56%, XLK Tech +2.77%, XLY Discretionary +1.08%, XLI Industrials +0.40%, XLV Healthcare +0.37%, XLRE Real Estate +0.14%, XLF Financials +0.00%, XLE Energy +0.00%, XLB Materials -0.56%, XLP Staples -1.06%, XLU Utilities -1.07%.
Top industries: IBIT +6.50% and SOXX +4.93%; bottom: XOP -3.07% and USO -3.68%. Flows: XLY +$711mm (100th pctile) and XLC +$133mm (65th) led inflows while XLE -$879mm (2nd) and XLF -$697mm (17th) bled out — flows confirm the growth/tech leadership. Money is in communications, tech and semis; it's leaving energy, financials and staples. Rotation state: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.82, QQQ 0.97 — neutral, not fearful.
QQQ skew +6.1% shows put premium demand while spot sits near the QQQ gamma flip of 730; VIXEQ at 38.7 vs VIX at 14.9 is a wide gap — high single-stock dispersion, a rotation tape rather than a correlated macro one.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil -3.68% with yields retreating (TLT +0.68%) and the dollar +0.32% is a growth-over-commodity, disinflationary transmission chain. Next FOMC: Oct 28, 2026 — CME FedWatch shows hike 100.0%, hold 0.0%, cut 0.0%; Polymarket prices 52% for a 25bp hike (5d +3pp) versus 46% for no change.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 48.5, Neutral.
Top movers: INTC +12.14% (bullish analyst actions), META +11.34% (2.6x vol), AMD +9.95% on hitting a $1tn market cap. Momentum extremes: XLK best 20d sector at +6.30%, XLB worst at -7.15%; IBIT leads baskets, XOP lags. Watch UNP -3.49% (2.5x vol, Freight 7), XLE at 0.00% flat yet bleeding $879mm in flows, and SLV with a 37.3% IV and gamma flip at 62.5.
